Extract pages

Pull out exactly the pages you need.

Copy selected pages into a new PDF, with quick presets for odd, even, first or second half. Optionally produce one PDF per page.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Extract pages works

  1. Add the PDF and choose pages.
  2. Use a preset or type a range.
  3. Extract one PDF or a ZIP of single pages.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Remove pages — Delete unwanted pages in one clean pass.
  • Split PDF — Break one document into the exact pages you need.
  • Merge PDF — Stitch PDFs together in exactly the order you want.
